description: Create an initiative (optionally under a program). MUST be connected to a repository — pass `codebaseId` (preferred) or `defaultGithubRepo` ("owner/name"); without one the request is rejected (repo_required) because its crews would have no workspace — unless `taskTracker` is set, since people deliver that work and no crew runs under it. De-dupes on name within the same codebase or program+repo, so re-runs return the existing one. Starts in DRAFT; dispatch the architect to decompose it into a backlog — unless `operatorPlanned` or `taskTracker` is set, in which case it starts IN_PROGRESS with no planner. Requires `write` scope.

additionalGithubRepos.description: Further repositories ("owner/name") this initiative's work items may modify, beside defaultGithubRepo — so an item can set targetGithubRepo to one of them. Replaces the list; [] clears it. Removing a repository is refused while a work item still targets it.

assignedOperatorId.description: Operator (DRI) uid — who the work is credited to, e.g. the "assigned to me" filter. Must be an approved editor-or-above member. Omit to default to the program owner, else you (the API key owner).

codebaseId.description: Linked codebase id, when created from a gap finding.

contextNotes.description: Intake notes: context the architect reads until the initiative has a spec (refused on update once a spec exists — edit the spec instead).

decompositionStrategy.description: Backlog shape: adaptive (default), single_work_item, or parallel_slices. Does not auto-dispatch crews.

defaultGithubBranch.description: Base branch the crews build on. Omit to inherit the repository's own default branch (resolved from the codebase, then GitHub) — there is no hard-coded "main" guess. A value you supply is checked against the remote and the real default is used if it does not exist there.

description.description: What needs to be done (the intent).

longLived.description: Set true for an ongoing delivery stream (e.g. a standing bug/intake queue) that should never receive the terminal integration-validation work item.

operatorPlanned.description: Set true for BOUNDED work the operator plans themselves — a sign-off gate, a migration runbook, a vendor dependency, a comms push. No architect run and no plan to approve: it starts IN_PROGRESS and its work items are filed directly. Still bounded, so milestones, the target date, capacity demand and closure all apply — unlike longLived, which is for work that never ends. The two are mutually exclusive.

programId.description: Parent program id (links it under a program).

taskTracker.description: Set true when PEOPLE deliver this initiative and AnyForge only tracks it, like a Jira board: its work items are filed, assigned, begun and marked done by hand, and NO crew ever runs under it (every dispatch is refused with initiative_task_tracker). No repository is required. Implies operatorPlanned on bounded work.

name: anyforge_create_initiative
title: Create initiative
